Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix audio continuing to play after app closes

Root cause: NAudio kept playing because OnExit() never fired when user closed
LibraryBrowserWindow. WPF''s default behavior keeps the app running until ALL
windows close, and PlayerWindow/PlaylistWindow/VisWindow remained open.

Fix implemented:

1. Set ShutdownMode.OnMainWindowClose in OnStartup
   - Ensures app exits when LibraryBrowserWindow closes
   - Other windows (PlayerWindow, etc.) can remain open but won''t block shutdown

2. Set Application.MainWindow = libraryWindow
   - Explicitly designate LibraryBrowserWindow as the main window
   - Closing this window now triggers OnExit() immediately

3. Add SessionEnding event handler
   - Handles Windows logoff/shutdown scenarios
   - Calls PlaybackService.Stop() before system shutdown

4. Explicit Stop() call in OnExit before Dispose()
   - Ensures audio stops even if Dispose() is called
   - Sequence: Stop() → SavePlaylist() → Dispose()
   - Stop() calls _wavePlayer.Stop() before _wavePlayer.Dispose()

Files changed:
- App.xaml.cs: Add MainWindow assignment, shutdown mode, SessionEnding handler, explicit Stop() in OnExit

Verification:
- Play track → Close app → Audio stops immediately
- Task Manager → DeadEditor.exe process exits cleanly
- Windows shutdown → SessionEnding stops playback before shutdown
